Do not skip cells that have partially filled neighbors to avoid cutting off detailed boundary surfaces potentially formed by particles overlapping cell boundaries; only inner full and empty cells may be skipped [S1].

- Packed Machine Words: Bits representing voxel occupancy, processed in chunks for efficiency [S1].

The claim states that bits representing voxel occupancy are processed in chunks (packed machine words) for efficiency. The evidence in Source [S1] explicitly states: 'To accelerate the iteration over voxel columns, we iterate over the packed machine words rather than single bits, using bit counting intrinsics to quickly determine the next relevant bits to be considered.' This confirms that the bits (representing voxel occupancy in the context of the simulation grid cells) are indeed processed in chunks (packed machine words) for the purpose of acceleration (efficiency).
